05 / How a coating job goes

Four steps between driven and delivered.

01

Look it over

Call or text, bring it by Nolana Loop and get a quote based on your paint, not a guess.

02

Wash & decon

A deep wash and decontamination so nothing gets polished into the paint.

03

Correct

Swirls and haze polished out under the bay lights, panel by panel.

04

Protect

Coating, film or tint goes on, and it rolls out ready for the RGV sun.
